attributes.morphology: petaloid in Nb5Si3 matrix, coarser at exterior margin

evidence.quote: Nb SS phase presents a petaloid morphology in Nb 5Si3 matrix and becomes coarser in the exterior margin.

blocks of Nb 5Si3 represent a faceted feature with a tetragonal morphology and correspond to a-Nb5Si3. Moreover, cracks are observed in the blocks. Nb 5Si3 blocks become finer with increasing withdawal rate, as the average width is y150, 50 and 50 mm in DS6, DS18 and DS36 respectively.

attributes.location: intercellular regions rich in Ti, Cr and Hf

evidence.quote: As the concentrations of Ti and Hf can promote the formation of c-Nb5Si3 phase, the Nb 5Si3 phase in the intercellular regions is supposed to be c-Nb5Si3, as reported in Refs. 13 and 14.
In DS6, most of Nb SSzNb5Si3 eutectic cells are with square corners and boundaries between cells are distinct ... The average width of eutectic cells is y150 mm

In DS18, except for eutectic cells with square corners, some eutectic cells emerge with a nearly round morphology in the cross section ... The average width of eutectic cells with square corners is reduced to y50 mm and the width of round eutectic cells is y25 mm.
In DS36, the volume fraction of round eutectic cells increases and the width of which decreases to y20 mm

attributes.location: reaction layer on rod surface, thickness ~1 um

evidence.quote: there is a reaction layer in the rod surface with thickness of y1 mm ... The EDS data of the white contract phase in Fig. 4 is 66 ?04Hf–33?06O and it is deﬁned to be HfO2.
The primary Nb 5Si3blocks are still present and cracks in Nb 5Si3 blocks remain during heat treatment.

attributes.morphology: net-like, parallel to growth direction, more uniform in HT36

evidence.quote: In HT18 and HT36, the boundaries of the round eutectic cells are eliminated as the Nb SS connect to be a network structure and the Nb 5Si3 become the discontinuous pieces ... the network microstructure of HT36 is more uniform.
Moreover, cracks are observed in the blocks.

attributes.morphology: continuous on side surface, propagating along Nb5Si3 or interface

evidence.quote: there are continuous cracks on the side surface of HT6, which are introduced into the Nb 5Si3 and propagate along the Nb5Si3 or the interface
The values of KQ and sb increase with increasing withdrawal rate and the maximums are 13?65 MPa m 1/2 and 389?16 MPa respectively.
